item.description: Approval of a one-year renewal (second extension) of the interlocal agreement with Emerald Coast Utilities Authority (ECUA) for the processing of recyclable materials at the ECUA Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) at the current processing rate of $60.00 per ton, and authorization for the chairman to execute all related documents.
